comment: Source read at SSE-One commit ff3505b, the head of main; its only change over c2d3c7f, the commit that raised plugin.json to 2.0.2, is a line of changes.md, so the code is the same. Two params have no widget and no click can reach them, so both are untagged: param 0, the double-click time for smart tie, is inside an #ifdef SMART_TIE that the Makefile never defines, and param 8 is an unused enum member the maker never configured or placed. Input 9, the Tran jack, is the one input the maker never named, so its tooltip is blank in the rack. The manual has Prev and Next the wrong way round: it says Prev moves the input position forward and Next moves it backward, while KeySeq.cpp:1208 and 1216 call prev() and next() respectively, which is the other way about. The whole of process() runs only on every eighth sample (KeySeq.cpp:845 with FRAME_DIVIDER 8 in plugin.hpp), so the gate length knob and the 200-block end-of-sequence pulse are counted in blocks of eight samples. One bug worth knowing: with the Play Input CV 0..10V option set, KeySeq.cpp:978 rounds the voltage to round(v / 10 * 12), which gives 12 at 10V, and KeySeq.cpp:985 admits any value up to and including 12; the sequence array holds twelve entries numbered 0 to 11, so a full 10V on the Play input reads past the end of it. The Reserved button, param 6, does nothing when pressed on its own (KeySeq.cpp:1295 clears it with a comment saying it is reserved for future expansion), but it is the ninth entry of the button-to-sequence table at KeySeq.cpp:1185, so while Sel or Copy is waiting it selects sequence 8.
